8. Themes, Backdrops & Liquid Glass Engine

Learn how Kanri pairs visual depth with butter-smooth 120 FPS performance on mid-range Android hardware.

1. The Five Visual Themes

  • Light (Warm Cream #FAF9F5): Soft, high-readability Japanese paper aesthetic with warm borders and high-contrast ink text.
  • Dark (Deep Ink #121212): Kanri's signature low-fatigue slate dark mode.
  • AMOLED (Pure Black #000000): Complete sub-pixel shutdown on OLED panels, maximizing battery longevity.
  • System: Follows Android's native day/night toggle automatically.
  • Liquid Glass: Dynamic translucent frosted glass cards floating above authentic animated art backdrops.

2. The Liquid Glass Engine (KanriGlass.kt)

In Glass mode, components render frosted blur with specular edge lighting:

  • Layer Isolation: Restricts expensive GPU blur passes strictly to floating overlays (navigation docks, entry sheets) to prevent "blur avalanche" lag.
  • 50% Downsampling: Utilizes HazeInputScale.Fixed(0.5f) to maintain crisp optical blur while slashing GPU compute loads by 75%.

3. AGSL GPU Shaders & 120 FPS Gesture Freeze

Running real-time shaders on Android devices with Mali GPUs (e.g. Mali-G57 MC2) can cause dropped frames during scrolling. Kanri applies strict optimizations:

  1. 16-Bit Half Precision: All AGSL vector math and noise evaluations are cast to half precision, doubling ALU throughput.
  2. Uniform Hoisting: The aspect ratio uniform (u_aspect) is precomputed on the CPU, eliminating 650,000 redundant divisions per frame.
  3. Touch-Pause Gesture Freeze: Driven by MainActivity.isUserInteracting: shader time advancement pauses during active screen drag and fling gestures, guaranteeing 100% of GPU power is reserved for 120Hz UI scroll inertia.
  4. Battery Saver Auto-Detect: Shaders automatically pause when Android enters Battery Saver mode or the screen is turned off.

4. Four Custom Launcher App Icons

Managed by AppIconManager.kt via Android activity aliases:

  • Classic Ink: The official dark Kanri emblem.
  • Cream Paper: Warm light-mode emblem.
  • Cyber Monochrome: Minimalist Nothing-inspired black-and-white icon.
  • Emerald Matrix: High-contrast green matrix emblem.
